'''''Gagea soleirolii'''''  is a [[Europe]]an flowering plant of the [[Liliaceae|lily family]]. It is native to [[Spain]] (including the [[Balearic Islands]]), [[France]] (including [[Corsica]]), [[Portugal]] and [[Sardinia]].<ref>[http://apps.kew.org/wcsp/namedetail.do?name_id=307425 Kew World Checklist of Selected Plant Families]</ref><ref>[http://luirig.altervista.org/flora/taxa/index1.php?scientific-name=gagea+soleirolii Altervista Flora Italiana, Cipollaccio giallo di Soleirol ''Gagea soleirolii'' F. W. Schultz]</ref><ref>Tison, J.M. (2009). An update of the genus ''Gagea'' Salisb. (Liliaceae) in the Iberian peninsula. Lagascalia 29: 7-22.</ref><ref>Peruzzi, L., Gestri, G. & Pierini, B. (2011). Distribution of the genus ''Gagea'' (Liliaceae) in Sardinia. Flora Mediterranea 21: 261-272.</ref>
